subject: general
question:
In the number 482818259, if 1 is added to all the digits placed at the even places starting from left and 1 is subtracted from the digits placed at the odd places starting from left, what will be the sum of the last 4 digits?

(Example: 697 - First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.
solution:
Given number → 482818259

If 1 is added to all the digits placed at the even places starting from left and 1 is subtracted from the digits placed at the odd places starting from left then,

New number → 3 9 1 9 0 9 1 6 8

The last four digits of the new number are:-

__9 ____**1 6 8**__

The sum of the last 4 digits is 1 + 6 + 8 + 9 = 24

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3".**
